<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_fix"><sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><before>false</before><description>Temporary test for certification point 4 (non-admin): evaluated as incidentConnect by a global impersonation script. Inserts test alerts. Runs only on ven07367. Delete before the next publish.</description><name>ZZ TEST - AM platform-default import che</name><record_for_rollback>true</record_for_rollback><script><![CDATA[// TEMPORARY TEST - delete before the next publish. HP WXP Alert Management, 22 Oct 2026.
// Tests the DEPLOYED AlertIngest.importBatch, unmodified, for certification point 4.
// Evaluated in the app scope as incidentConnect by a global script that impersonates it.
// B3: a batch of 3 new alerts. B10: one malformed alert and one good one.
// All alerts are NEW with fresh u_ids, so they only insert incidents and nothing goes to Fastn.
// Runs only on hp-dev (ven07367).
(function() {
    var TAG = '[AM-DEPLOYED-TEST]';
    var label = (typeof runLabel !== 'undefined') ? runLabel : 'manual';
    if (gs.getProperty('instance_name') != 'ven07367') {
        gs.info(TAG + ' skipped - not ven07367');
        return;
    }

    gs.info(TAG + ' ' + label + ' identity ' + JSON.stringify({
        user: gs.getUserName(),
        scope: gs.getCurrentScopeName(),
        admin: gs.hasRole('admin'),
        appUser: gs.hasRole('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.user')
    }));

    var runId = 'zz-deptest-' + label + '-' + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue();

    report('B3-bulk', new AlertIngest().importBatch([buildAlert('b3-1'), buildAlert('b3-2'), buildAlert('b3-3')]));

    var bad = buildAlert('b10-bad');
    bad.u_devicedetails = '{not valid json';
    report('B10-bad-row', new AlertIngest().importBatch([bad, buildAlert('b10-good')]));

    gs.info(TAG + ' ' + label + ' done run=' + runId);

    function report(step, outcome) {
        var incidents = outcome.incidents || [];
        var summary = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < incidents.length; i++)
            summary.push({
                u_id: incidents[i].u_id,
                incidentId: incidents[i].incidentId,
                displayId: incidents[i].displayId,
                newState: incidents[i].newState,
                error: incidents[i].error
            });
        gs.info(TAG + ' ' + label + ' ' + step + ' ' + JSON.stringify({
            ok: outcome.ok,
            status: outcome.status,
            error: outcome.error,
            import_set: outcome.import_set,
            import_set_id: outcome.import_set_id,
            batch_size: outcome.batch_size,
            incidents: summary
        }));
    }

    function buildAlert(suffix) {
        return {
            eventType: 'INCIDENT_CREATED',
            schemaVersion: '1.0',
            alertRuleId: 'zz-deptest-rule',
            itsmType: 'SERVICENOW',
            deviceAlertId: runId + '-device-' + suffix,
            u_id: runId + '-' + suffix,
            u_title: '[TEST deployed ' + suffix + '] Platform-default import check - please ignore',
            u_description: 'Created on 22 Oct 2026 by a temporary test of the deployed AlertIngest, run as incidentConnect. Safe to delete.',
            u_status: '{"name": "NEW", "value": "New"}',
            u_impact: '3',
            u_urgency: '3',
            u_assignmentgroupid: 'Service Desk',
            u_category: 'Software',
            u_subcategory: 'Operating System',
            u_devicedetails: '{"deviceName": "ZZ-TEST-DEVICE"}',
            u_sourcelocation: 'zz-deptest'
        };
    }
})();
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_fix</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 06:12:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>c77797822b44d754eb1cfbfdf291bf81</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ZZ TEST - AM platform-default import che</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fix_c77797822b44d754eb1cfbfdf291bf81</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 08:44:15</sys_updated_on><unloadable>false</unloadable></sys_script_fix></record_update>
